notes:
Detail scales, safer numbers, and big plan sets that stay up.

- **Detail scale boxes.** A 1 1/2" detail on a 1/4" sheet now measures right:
  drag a box around the detail (+ Detail scale, by the sheet's scale) and pick
  its scale — it is read off the sheet when it says one. Marks inside measure at
  it. The bid check warns when a sheet lists two scales and has no box. The
  scale list gains 1/16", 3/32", 1 1/2", 3" and 6".
- **New condition types:** Trench (CY + LF), Stair (risers, tread/riser SF,
  concrete CY, LF up the slope) and Pier / caisson (EA + CY).
- **Each leg's length** can show along a run, on screen and in the export;
  click a leg to read it.
- **Presets:** save a condition's setup and start new ones from it.
- **Callouts jump:** "3/A-501" on a sheet is a link to A-501 in Select mode.
- **Money fixes:** the Excel export no longer double-counts lines or mixes
  alternates into the base; assemblies now honour Occurs, Factor, Sub and
  Markup on their row; the spoken-scope card shows the real amount. Bids
  with those assembly settings will price differently — correctly.
- **Faster and lighter:** with a job open and nothing happening the app now
  uses almost no CPU (it was a quarter of a core, forever); marking up uses a
  tenth of what it did; autosave no longer rewrites the whole plan set every
  five seconds; memory after an export drops from about 5.6 GB to under 1 GB
  on a 62-sheet set; plan sets open faster; and paging a big set no longer
  grows memory until the window crashes.
- **Tabs:** work started in one tab always lands in that tab.
- **Safety:** files are written whole or not at all; a damaged jobs list or
  settings file is kept rather than written over; recovered work is kept until
  it is safely saved; photo pins follow a job between Macs.
- **Updates:** if a new build ever fails to start, the previous one is put
  back automatically and you are told.
- **Help → Send Diagnostics…** saves one file to send when something is off —
  no projects in it, no passwords or keys, nothing sent anywhere.
- Spot elevations now appear in exported and printed PDFs.
